verdict.rationale: pnpm's homepage directly claims first-class monorepo filtering that runs tasks on just the projects you touched, which covers filtered scripts and change-affected selection. A community user also confirms recursive/parallel workspace commands replaced Lerna. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no filter syntax or CLI reference documented, and nothing shows that installs can be filtered to a subset of packages. Missing for 10: documented filtering of installs to a package subset, detailed filter/changed-since selector docs, and hands-on corroboration of affected-only runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run installs and scripts filtered to a subset of workspace packages (including only those affected by a change)

citations.quote: filtering to run tasks on just the projects you touched
Recursive/parallel commands replaced my need for Lerna.
